corrections: Undated page retains stale workforce count and overbroad first-direct-listing-in-Europe claim; omit both. Seven years after 2002 conflicts with other biographies ending Skype role in 2008; avoid exact leaving year until resolved.
Header CEO and body chairman are outdated Wise titles, not current evidence. Do not use copyright year as biography update date.
Company now labeled Wise Limited; this appointment does not encompass all earlier group roles. Filed information not independently verified by registrar. No private address reproduced.

Nearby David Wells biography says December 9 while appointment and resignation narrative say December 8. Use corroborated Hinrikus resignation date. Ending board role does not prove all employment ended that date.

Contradicts CDL bachelor-degree assertion; prioritize specific filed prospectus and do not assert bachelor. Historical executive-chair title not current. No exact coding-school or Certific launch date established here.
Bachelor conflicts with filed prospectus dropout wording. Stale Wise chairman and recently launched Certific language; do not repeat as current roles or verified bachelor.

Fund amount is launch announcement, not necessarily eventual close. Corporate marketing comparisons are not independent facts. Founder surname appears Heloui in one sentence and Helioui in quote attribution.
Do not assign entire capital to a single early-stage vehicle without breakdown. Fundraising is institutional/team activity, not personal fortune. Page date differs from November 16 press coverage.
Commitment differs from fully disbursed money. Quotes belong Khaled Helioui and bank officials, not Hinrikus. Institutional current event alone not personal appearance evidence.
Round total is not personal or sole Plural check; technical superiority and future returns are investor claims, not independently validated results. Do not mistake investor for chip inventor.
Direct listing differs from conventional fundraising IPO. Updated company boilerplate contains FY2025 statistics, not contemporaneous 2021 figures. Avoid overbroad first-in-Europe claim.
2010 development and early 2011 first-version launch follow explicit first-person chronology; not a precise company incorporation claim.
Education uses INSEAD MBA class and specific prospectus statement that Tallinn computer science studies were not completed. Conflicting CDL bachelor assertion excluded.
December 8, 2021 chair and director departure corroborated by annual report and registration; do not infer all employment ended. Old chairman/CEO biographies not treated as current.
Plural November 14 announcement corroborated by November 16 bank release; EUR1bn covers early-stage and follow-on capital, not sole fund vehicle or personal wealth.
OLIX total financing round not sole investor contribution; investor forecasts and technical superiority not asserted as independent validation.
Skype first employee is not a cofounder claim. Exact leaving year omitted due to discrepancy between seven-year narrative and 2008 institutional biographies.
